_comment: THE PICKER/ENDPOINT REGISTER — one row per screen control that offers a
list of ids which some OTHER endpoint then has to accept.
Written 2026-08-15 from DEF-114: the S15 Assign-plan picker was filled from
GET /rate-schedules while POST /units/{id}/plan-assignments resolved the id
against rate_plans, so every option the screen offered was refused
422 VAL-005 metering.plan.tariff_unknown. Both halves were correct on their
own and both halves were tested; nothing in the repo compared them. It was
the second such pair in one day (DEF-095: a period parameter named f.from on
one side and from on the other).
TWO LOCKS READ THIS FILE, and neither can stand in for the other:
· 10-scripts/gates/g22_picker_vocabulary.py — STATIC. No database. It
re-extracts each wrapper's path literal out of the frontend and fails
when a picker is repointed without this register moving with it, and
when a registered picker is not called by any screen.
· 06-backend/tests/test_def_114_picker_vocabulary.py — LIVE. It reads the
SAME path literal out of the frontend, calls it against a real database,
and posts what it serves at the real write endpoint. That is the half a
comment cannot fake (hard-won law 1) and the half that goes red on the
defect itself rather than on a description of it.
PROVED RED 2026-08-15, both locks, and the SECOND proof is the point:
· repointing the picker at /rate-schedules and leaving this file alone —
G22 FAIL: "picker `getUnitPlanOptions` calls '/rate-schedules', register
says '/plans'".
· repointing the picker AND moving this row with it, so the static lock
agrees with itself — G22 PASS, and the live probe fails with the
customer's own refusal: "the picker offered 'Residential Draft — electric'
… and the endpoint refused it: {'code': 'VAL-005', 'message_key':
'metering.plan.tariff_unknown' …} assert 422 == 201".
TO ADD A ROW: a picker belongs here the moment a screen offers ids from one
endpoint to another. `list_query` is the query the wrapper actually sends.

pairs.screens: S15 (Assign plan · Bulk assign plan) · S16 default-plan panel
pairs.constraint_note: BR-RAT-030 — only a PUBLISHED plan is assignable; plan_ref filters on exactly that, so an unfiltered picker would offer drafts the endpoint refuses with the same unknown-plan message.
pairs.id_field_note: The SCREEN's field name. apps/metering/services._apply_unit_plan accepts plan_id OR tariff_id and reports its refusal against `tariff_id`, which is the id the S15 form field carries — so the field name stays and only what it POINTS AT moved.
